messages:
Ava (Product): Quick ask — we need a 45m timeboxed RFC review for RFC-412 (smart routing policy + fallback variants). Can ENG leads + Platform + Design join? Proposed slots below.

Diego (Eng): I can do Tue morning PT. Wed's tight for me.

Priya (ENG - Latency): Tue works for me too, but prefer 45m and strict agenda: 15m summary, 20m tradeoffs, 10m open actions.

Maya (Design): I can make Tue or Thu. Would like to see a short mock of UX failure states first.

Samir (Platform): Thu afternoon would be best for infra signoff, but I can join Tue if it's important. If we pick Tue, can we keep infra checklist as an async pre-read?

Noah (Solutions): Customer-facing concerns — prefer Tue so we can surface blocker customers before the sprint ends.

Ava (Product): Cool — sounds like Tue is the common preference. Proposed concrete slots: 1) Tue 4/12 10:00 PT (45m) 2) Wed 4/13 09:00 PT (45m) 3) Thu 4/14 16:00 PT (30m quick sync). Please react with :one:, :two:, :three: or reply if you need different times. We'll lock when we have majority.

Diego (Eng): :one: works for me.

Priya (ENG - Latency): :one: and +1 on the pre-read. I'll add perf microbench notes to the doc by EOD.

Maya (Design): :one: but will upload UX failure mocks to the thread before the meeting.

Samir (Platform): :one: (will skim pre-read) — if infra later needs more time we can follow up with a 15m ops check.

calendar-bot: Created poll: https://calendar.redwood/doodle/abc123 — votes recorded. Event draft: "RFC-412 — Smart routing policy review" 45m Tue 4/12 10:00 PT.

Ava (Product): Thanks — I'll mark agenda owners: Priya for perf summary, Diego for implementation plan, Maya for UX failure states, Samir to confirm infra constraints. Noah to list customer impact items.

Diego (Eng): Small ask — can we reserve the first 5 minutes for constraints table: CPU/latency targets + fallback SLOs? I'll paste the table now:

Diego (Eng): ```
Constraints:
- P50 infer latency target: < 80ms
- Fallback model latency: < 50ms extra
- Max CPU burst: 70% for autoscale windows
```

Priya (ENG - Latency): Thanks — will validate numbers vs current traces. If those hold, 45m should be fine.

Maya (Design): Uploaded mocks: https://files.redwood/design/rfc412-failure-mocks.png

Noah (Solutions): I'll prepare a 3-slide customer impact blurb to keep discussion focused.

Ava (Product): OK locking Tue 4/12 10:00 PT 45m. Calendar invite sent to participants. Agenda in doc: summary -> perf -> implementation -> UX failure -> decision + action owners. If anyone can't make it, ping me and we'll set a delegate. :thumbsup:

Samir (Platform): Noted. If infra needs deeper follow-up, queue a 15m ops huddle right after.

calendar-bot: Event confirmed: RFC-412 review — Tue 4/12 10:00 PT (45m). Invite: https://calendar.redwood/event/efg456

Ava (Product): Thanks all — will post pre-read links and the lightweight decision template in the doc. See you Tue.
